This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This nervous individual was an informant of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. After the Bestine political election, he attempted to gather incriminating information about the mayor [[Sean Trenwell]].<ref name="SWG:STq" />
